messages:
rhea: FYI saw an unusual reconnect "bloom" on SSE route 'live-ops' in eu-central at 21:10 UTC. Console shows lots of short sessions + a strange routing fallback to a different shard. Anyone digging in?

dylan: noticed it. Clients keep getting 204 then immediately reconnecting. But interestingly ~20% of reconnects were routed to shard-b instead of shard-a due to route-weight-smoothing kicking in. That increased cross-shard state misses.

kai: logs snippet: ```
[21:10:03] edge: route=live-ops status=204 conn=444 closed by upstream
[21:10:03] client: reconnect attempt=1 backoff=0s token=tok_qr
[21:10:03] router: selected shard=shard-b reason=weight-smoothing
[21:10:04] billing: session.create id=evt_2001 token=tok_qr route=live-ops
```

sree: weight-smoothing was tuned earlier today to avoid hot-shard spikes. But if the session was tombstoned quickly then rerouting causes a new session on different shard with no KV cache -> extra work and billing.

rhea: infra-bot: can you give delta on session.create and cross-shard creates in that window?

infra-bot: [automated] session.create for route "live-ops" increased 3.2x between 21:08 and 21:12 UTC. Cross-shard session create ratio (shard-b when previous was shard-a) increased from 2% to 18% in same window.

dylan: mitigation: 1) revert weight-smoothing tweak (quick) 2) server: treat 204 as soft-close for 300ms to avoid immediate recreates and to prefer sticky shard on quick reconnects 3) router: if reconnect within 500ms prefer previous shard (sticky-rejoin) 4) billing: dedupe create events by token+recent-shard to avoid double billing.

kai: prefer server debounce + router sticky-rejoin; clients will be slow to patch. Also add a console overlay: show per-route shard-swap rate and reconnect spikes side-by-side. That would've made correlation faster.

sree: agree. small nuance: sticky-rejoin increases load on the old shard if it's unhealthy; need a cheap health-check before forcing stickiness. Maybe prefer stickiness only if recent-success metric for that shard > 90%.

rhea: noted. console-bot: can we add an inspect overlay that links recent routing-config changes and feature flags next to shard-swap spikes?

console-bot: [automated] Idea filed: CON-5012 - per-route shard-swap heatmap + flag-config overlay.

dylan: opened quick rollback for weight-smoothing at 21:16 UTC. metrics returning to baseline.

kai: follow-ups / owners: server soft-204 debounce (kai), router sticky-rejoin w/ health-check (dylan), billing dedupe (niranjan), console overlay + alert rule (josh).

sree: also add an alert: when cross-shard session-create > baseline*5 AND reconnect-rate > baseline*2 -> page eng-platform with top tokens and last 5 routing changes.

rhea: i'll schedule a 30m post-incident sync and add a short blameless note. small doc ask for devex: add a best-practice on client reconnect jitter + prefer exponential backoff when receiving 204/early-close.

dylan: PR #9450 created for router:sticky-rejoin prototype behind flag ROUTER-STICKY-REJOIN. Tests simulate 204->reconnect to verify hit-rate on same shard.

kai: PR #9451 created for server debounce (300ms) + integration test.

rhea: thanks all. closing once tickets are tracked. :white_check_mark:
